service_description: API for discovering events, calendars, and places on the Luma platform.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Use this tool first to find cities on Luma. Returns featured places with their api_id (e.g. discplace-...), name and description. Pass a place's api_id to get_place_events to list its events.

parameters.name: featured_place_api_id
parameters.description: The API ID of a specific place to feature and highlight on the discover page.

tools.name: get_place_calendars
tools.description: Retrieve a list of calendars associated with a specific discoverable place. Use this when the user asks for calendars related to a known place.

parameters.name: discover_place_api_id
parameters.description: The unique API ID of the discoverable place.

tools.name: get_place_events
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of events for a specific discoverable place. Use this when the user asks for events happening at a particular location.

parameters.name: discover_place_api_id
parameters.description: The unique API ID of the discoverable place.

parameters.name: pagination_limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of events to return per page. Defaults to a platform-defined limit if not specified.

tools.name: get_place_details
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details about a specific discoverable place, such as its name, description, or general location information. Use this when the user asks for information about a specific place.

parameters.name: discover_place_api_id
parameters.description: The unique API ID of the discoverable place.

tools.name: get_place_map_points
tools.description: Retrieve geographical coordinates and other data specifically required to display a mini-map for a specific discoverable place. Use this when an agent needs to visualize the location of a place on a map.

parameters.name: discover_place_api_id
parameters.description: The unique API ID of the discoverable place.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all available discoverable categories on the Luma platform. Use this when the user asks for different types or categories of discoverable items.

parameters.name: pagination_limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of categories to return per page. Defaults to a platform-defined limit if not specified.
